questions.stem: An object is moving from left to right on a screen. What is its direction of motion?
questions.solution: The object's direction of motion is to the right.
questions.explanation: Direction of motion refers to the path an object takes. In this case, the object moves from left to right.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake would be choosing 'Left', which is opposite to the actual direction.

questions.stem: A car is driving north on a map. What is its direction of motion?
questions.solution: The car's direction of motion is north.
questions.explanation: Direction of motion indicates the path an object takes. In this case, the car moves along the northern direction.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake would be choosing 'South', which is opposite to the actual direction.

questions.stem: An airplane is flying in a counterclockwise circle around a地标. What is its overall direction of motion?
questions.solution: The airplane's direction of motion is counterclockwise.
questions.explanation: Direction of motion describes the general path an object takes. In this case, the airplane moves in a counterclockwise circle.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake would be choosing 'Clockwise', which is opposite to the actual direction.

questions.stem: A boat is drifting with the current towards the east shore. What is its direction of motion?
questions.solution: The boat's direction of motion is east.
questions.explanation: Direction of motion indicates the path an object follows. In this case, the boat moves along the eastern direction.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake would be choosing 'West', which is opposite to the actual direction.

questions.stem: A ball rolls off a table and falls to the floor. What is its direction of motion?
questions.solution: The ball's direction of motion is downwards.
questions.explanation: Direction of motion describes the path an object takes. In this case, the ball moves in a downward direction due to gravity.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake would be choosing 'Upwards', which is opposite to the actual direction.

questions.stem: A satellite orbits around Earth in an elliptical path. What is its average direction of motion?
questions.solution: The satellite's average direction of motion is tangential to the orbit.
questions.explanation: Direction of motion in this context refers to the satellite's path around Earth. The satellite follows a tangential path at all points on its orbit.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake would be choosing 'Towards Earth's center' or 'Away from Earth's center', which is not consistent with the satellite's elliptical orbit.

questions.stem: A rollercoaster car goes up a steep incline and then down a drop. What are the two main directions of motion?
questions.solution: The rollercoaster car's main directions of motion are up and down.
questions.explanation: Direction of motion in this context refers to changes in elevation. The car moves upwards on the incline and then downwards during the drop.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake would be choosing 'Left, Right' or 'Forward, Backward', which are not the primary directions of motion in this scenario.
